generate_images_with_ernie_pipeline: generate images from text prompts using the ErnieImagePipeline with classifier-free guidance and flow matching
enhance_prompt_with_pe_model: enhance a short text prompt using the PE model to rewrite it with resolution-aware details
encode_prompt_to_embeddings: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the text encoder model
patchify_latents_for_transformer: patchify latent tensors from 32 channels to 128 channels using 2x2 spatial patching
pad_text_embeddings_for_batch: pad a list of text hidden state tensors to a uniform batch tensor with length tracking
